notes.title: 23.07.03 Updated
notes.content:
Based on player feedback, make the following modifications:

1. There are too many things to try in the game, but there is a setting to delete archives, which is unreasonable. This update will remove this setting, and the number of deaths will still be recorded

2. Improved fault tolerance for players, increased basic birth value, and increased money acquisition during growth

3. Price reduction of all random goods

4. [Restore Blood Bottles] has been changed to free, [Increase Maximum Blood Bottle Limit] consumption of gold coins has been reduced, and a new record of the total number of blood bottles used has been added

5. Basic combo guidance and partial guidance have been added to the introduction of the game Steam. Players who have not played similar games can consider reading to improve the game experience
